# Third-party sources

- Speaker Badge by Hervé Studio, MIT, pinned at c9ed3efaf40a668fe0d3bec3d1aa91f52d58fab4: https://github.com/hervestudio/firmware-badge. License: SPEAKER-MIT.txt. `firmware/touch/speaker_motion.h` adapts `src/main.cpp`'s getIdle/pickNewLookTarget and `src/menu_ui.h`'s UiBubble/uiDrawHome. Changes: explicit instance ownership, injected time, C++ standard types, finite time guard, local non-security random source and display-scale-independent positions. `firmware/touch/avatar.cpp` adapts `src/anims_extra.h`'s irGenFrame sphere shading to Alook's face color and transparent RGB565 output. No original account, ESP-NOW, GPIO or reset logic is imported.
- Waveshare ESP32-S3-Touch-AMOLED-1.75C, Apache-2.0, pinned at b1f60c6fa708099bc3f1e9cb9e81d72b2e435c37: https://github.com/waveshareteam/ESP32-S3-Touch-AMOLED-1.75C. License: WAVESHARE-APACHE-2.0.txt. `firmware/touch/board.cpp` adapts Arduino 03_LVGL_AXP2101_ADC_Data and 05_LVGL_Widgets. Changes: one LVGL owner, bounded display buffer, polling without demo/reset behavior, actual button transitions and retained native power semantics. Vendor driver libraries retain their licenses in the pinned download.
- Noto Sans CJK SC Regular, SIL Open Font License 1.1, pinned at f8d157532fbfaeda587e826d4cd5b21a49186f7c: https://github.com/notofonts/noto-cjk/tree/f8d157532fbfaeda587e826d4cd5b21a49186f7c/Sans. License: NOTO-OFL.txt. `tools/font.py` converts the selected Unicode ranges into an ignored LVGL font using lv_font_conv 1.5.3. The derivative font symbol is `alook_font_cjk`. Preview labels use the same font file.
- Lilita One by Juan Pablo del Peral, SIL Open Font License 1.1, pinned Google Fonts source at b9f4a43f3684f93a02b88133755deb51508c2fcf: https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/b9f4a43f3684f93a02b88133755deb51508c2fcf/ofl/lilitaone. License: LILITA-ONE-OFL.txt. `tools/font.py` creates 24px and 32px LVGL UI fonts. Speaker's README reserves rights to its embedded/Dingos fonts; these are not copied. Lilita One supplies the heavy display type for the adapted menu hierarchy.
- Generated face features and palettes come directly from this repository's `src/web/src/lib/avatar/{face,theme}.ts` through `tools/assets.mts`; the logo comes from `assets/alook.svg`. The preview's example custom photo is this repository's `src/web/public/landing/people/lin.webp`, used only as sample content.

Dependency archives, versions and SHA-256 values are in dependencies.lock.json. Tooling downloads them into the ignored task-local .cache directory. Source licenses and required notices remain with copied or adapted code.
